note: DTN Content Services cash-bids-table-widget. Read from ONE call to https://api.dtn.com/markets/sites/E0031301/cash-bids?units=us — the site id E0031301 carries this location and its neighbours together, so every one of them is a source file and none of them is new code. IT IS READ THROUGH A BROWSER AND NOT BY A FETCH: DTN answered a server-side probe with "The api key is valid, but it is valid to be used within a browser only", so their gateway scopes these widget keys to browser use. poll.mjs loads https://fscooperatives.com/insightfs/agriculture/grain-marketing/cash-bids in a real Chromium and reads the response their own widget asks for, which means we hold no key at all — theirs is public in their page, as it must be for the widget to work. THE LOCATION KEY IS THE NUMERIC location.id (4274) AND NOT THE NAME: a display name is exactly the thing a vendor re-cases, and some of these names are companies rather than towns. cashRounding is absent because no single rule explained every testable row on this board. The identity guard stays exact. COORDINATES ARE NULL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the feed carries no coordinate, and a town centroid is a different place from a yard — measured at 1.4 miles on babgrain-auburn. Geocode the street address before relying on a map pin. Built by scripts/dtn-build.mjs from a dtn-probe log; 8 row(s) for this location. Supplied by Sig on 2026-08-25 from the operator's own location directory. Insight FS's own page names Jefferson and says "23 locations" without listing them, so Ixonia could not be read off it. ROUNDING MEASURED 2026-08-26. Residuals on this board run BOTH ways -- Ixonia's corn sits at -0.5c while Jefferson's beans sit at +0.75c, on the same site id, at the same instant. No directional rule can hold on both, and one fitted to a single day's rows is exactly the thing that breaks tomorrow. Both signs is the signature of the CASH AND THE BASIS each being displayed rounded to the cent while the futures move on a quarter-cent grid, and that bounds the residual: 0.5c from the cash cell plus 0.25c from the tick is 0.75c. The tolerance is that derived bound, not a number chosen to make the run green. A moved column shows up as tens of cents and is still refused.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
